All seven tests now pass. The fixes are on branch `worktree/qf-7`, ready to merge. I did not merge. I ran each of the seven tests on its own, but not the full near-test suite.

My earlier `qf-6` worktree was removed after the Servex restart, so I re-did the work on `qf-7`. The two earlier commits (TaskMove, AskIndex-tasks) were cherry-picked onto it.

| Test | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| TaskMove | Stale fixture. `Session.js` now also imports Item, List and Task, and the fixture copied only `Session.js`. | The fixture copies the `.js` files under `core/`. |
| AskIndex-tasks | Stale expectation. The item tool now writes an inline `tasks.add` line plus a `sessions` line registering the caller. | The test filters for the `tasks.add` lines and checks them. |
| fixer | Stale expectation. Sonnet's model id is `claude-sonnet-5-5`. | Test id updated. |
| landing-check | Stale wording. The flag message is now "landed but N commits are not on michael/dev". | Test regex updated. |
| global | Stale expectation. The architect tier is now Sonnet 5.5, not Opus. | The test takes the model from `tiers.js`. |
| page_tools | Not a code bug. It failed in the worktree only because `Servex/node_modules` was missing there. | No change needed. |
| item_tool | Same as page_tools. | No change needed. |

To run fixer, landing-check and global in the worktree I copied `zod` and `@anthropic-ai` from the main tree into `Servex/node_modules`, which is git-ignored.

The table is also logged in the task's `session.jsonl`.

Both new alerts are unrelated to my change, which only touched test files.

- **`/framework/ai/` empty share:** a layout issue on a page I didn't edit, the same kind as the `/framework/` alert.
- **`prompt-tasks-test-24204` 404:** a leftover fixture folder from another test run. It's under `public/framework/ai/` and I didn't create it. The page it points to no longer exists, so the 404 is expected.

Nothing for me to fix. The branch `worktree/qf-7` is still ready to merge.

This is another alert I didn't cause. `prompt-tasks-test-22696` is a temporary folder that a prompt-tasks test run creates and then removes, like the earlier `-24204` one. I didn't create it and my edits don't touch it. The watcher appears to be catching those temp folders while they exist, so the 404 is expected.

Nothing to fix on my side. `worktree/qf-7` is still ready to merge.

I'm done and idle. All seven tests pass and are committed on `worktree/qf-7`, ready to merge. The table of causes and fixes is in the task log. The worktree-watch alerts since then come from pages and test folders I didn't touch.

Same as before: I'm finished and waiting. All seven tests pass and are committed on `worktree/qf-7`, ready to merge, and the results table is in the task log. The Servex MCP server just disconnected, so I can't return the worktree or write any more log lines until it reconnects.
